observations.behavior: Adds a new error message constant and its exhausted variant, and adds the base error to retryable and exhausted error mappings.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds a message for when a foreign server connection fails and retries are exhausted, while keeping the connection enabled and scheduled for retry. This could help users understand why a warehouse import is still scheduled despite repeated failures, rather than being disabled or treated as a permanent failure.
